info.title: GovCon Section 508, WCAG 2.2 AA & VPAT 2.5 Auditor API
info.description: Audits software, SaaS, mobile, and document deliverables against Revised Section 508 (36 CFR Part 1194), WCAG 2.2 Level A/AA, and state digital accessibility mandates (CO HB 21-1110, CA Gov Code 7405, TX TAC 206, IL IITAA 2.1) to generate a complete VPAT 2.5 Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) table, remediation engineering roadmap, and Section L/M proposal conformance narrative.
